data.body: Triage 2026-10-25 (bug sweep): not worked, no code changed. The ticket offers two fixes that differ in meaning: skip the test with a clear reason when ssh-keygen is older than 8.9, or provision OpenSSH on the Windows runner. Skipping hides whether per-store opcert key isolation holds on Windows; provisioning changes the CI workflow, which cannot be exercised from this macOS host. That choice is a project decision, so it is left open for it.
